cues.en: Educator: I hope you're not too hungry because I'm going to talk about pie charts in this video.
cues.zh: 希望你現在不太餓，因為這部影片要談圓餅圖。

cues.en: Ugh, let me also apologize for that terrible joke, that was not planned, it just sort of popped out.
cues.zh: 呃，也為這個爛笑話道歉，不是事先安排，只是不小心說出來。

cues.en: Anyway, here's what a pie chart looks like.
cues.zh: 總之，這就是圓餅圖的樣子。

cues.en: It looks like a circle, like a pie, and then you have these pieces in different colors with some labels on the different pieces.
cues.zh: 像個圓、像個派，切成不同顏色的塊，每塊有標籤。

cues.en: This is actually a comic from a web comic called xkcd.com.
cues.zh: 這其實是來自xkcd.com網路漫畫的一幅作品。

cues.en: If you're not familiar with xkcd, they're pretty funny, they're quite clever, insightful, intelligent comics, so I recommend checking it out.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉xkcd，漫畫很好笑，也很聰明、有洞見、充滿智慧，建議看看。

cues.en: I'll have several more of these xkcd comics throughout the rest of this course.
cues.zh: 課程剩下的部分，還會出現幾幅xkcd漫畫。

cues.en: Alright, so let's have a slightly more crisp example.
cues.zh: 再看一個稍微明確的例子。

cues.en: So let's say we go out and do a survey with a bunch of people.
cues.zh: 假設出去對一群人做問卷。

cues.en: We say, "What is your favorite ice cream flavor?
cues.zh: 問：「最喜歡哪種冰淇淋口味？

cues.en: And you're only allowed to pick one flavor, so what is it?"
cues.zh: 只能選一種，是哪種？」

cues.en: We ask a lot of different people, and we convert the numbers that we get back for each category into percentages, and then we can plot it in a pie chart.
cues.zh: 問很多不同的人，把每個類別得到的數量轉成百分比，再畫成圓餅圖。

cues.en: So you see a lot of people like vanilla flavored ice cream.
cues.zh: 可以看到，很多人喜歡香草冰淇淋。

cues.en: Quite a few people like chocolate, and there's green tea flavored ice cream is also pretty popular.
cues.zh: 不少人喜歡巧克力，綠茶冰淇淋也很受歡迎。

cues.en: And then we have a couple of strange people who prefer penguin fur flavored ice cream.
cues.zh: 接著有幾個奇怪的人，偏好企鵝毛口味的冰淇淋。

cues.en: I have no idea what that tastes like, although I guess it's appropriate for something cold like ice cream.
cues.zh: 不知道吃起來如何，不過我猜，對冰淇淋這種冷食，倒是合適。

cues.en: I certainly hope they don't use actual penguin fur in penguin fur flavored ice cream.
cues.zh: 真希望企鵝毛口味冰淇淋，不會真的使用企鵝毛。

cues.en: Okay, so these are the categories, these are the labels, and we can also show here the percentages.
cues.zh: 這些是類別、這些是標籤，也能顯示百分比。

cues.en: So 36% of people responded with vanilla.
cues.zh: 36%的人回答香草。

cues.en: So this pie here, this piece of the pie here takes up 36% of the total pie,
cues.zh: 所以這塊圓餅，占整個圓餅的36%，

cues.en: and 14% of our respondents said they like penguin fur flavored ice cream.
cues.zh: 14%的受訪者，則說喜歡企鵝毛口味。

cues.en: So this piece of the pie here is 14% of the total area of the pie.
cues.zh: 所以這塊占總面積的14%。

cues.en: So that's the basics of what a pie chart looks like.
cues.zh: 這就是圓餅圖外觀的基本概念。

cues.en: And so we can ask a question, what type of data are these in this particular example?
cues.zh: 可以問，這個特定例子的資料類型是什麼？

cues.en: Have you guessed it?
cues.zh: 猜到了嗎？

cues.en: Well, these are nominal data, they have categories, and they're not ordinal because they have no intrinsic sorting.
cues.zh: 是名目資料，有類別，沒有內在排序，所以不是次序資料。

cues.en: There is some subjective sorting of course, but there's no intrinsic sorting between chocolate and vanilla.
cues.zh: 當然可以有主觀排序，但巧克力與香草之間，沒有內在順序。

cues.en: Okay, so here's another question.
cues.zh: 另一個問題。

cues.en: What types of data in general can be shown in pie charts, not just this particular example, but what kinds of data can be shown in pie charts?
cues.zh: 一般而言，哪些資料類型能用圓餅圖呈現？不限這個例子，而是哪些類型都能？

cues.en: Again, if you'd like to pause the video and take a moment to think about it, now is your chance to do so.
cues.zh: 如果想暫停、花點時間思考，現在可以。

cues.en: So it turns out that the types of data that can be shown in pie charts are nominal, ordinal, and discreet.
cues.zh: 圓餅圖能顯示名目、次序與離散資料。

cues.en: So if you have data that are ratio or interval and you want to show them in a pie chart, you have to bin them into groups somehow.
cues.zh: 如果是比率或區間資料，卻想放進圓餅圖，必須設法分箱。

cues.en: You have to come up with bin boundaries and convert your interval or ratio data into some other either ordinal or discreet data.
cues.zh: 決定區間邊界，把區間或比率資料，轉成某種次序或離散資料。

cues.en: Okay, so here's another question.
cues.zh: 再問一個問題。

cues.en: What is the condition on the data for a pie chart to be a valid representation?
cues.zh: 要讓圓餅圖有效呈現資料，資料必須符合什麼條件？

cues.en: This is not such a trivial question.
cues.zh: 這不是那麼簡單的問題。

cues.en: You might wanna take a moment to think about this.
cues.zh: 可以花點時間思考。

cues.en: What is the condition on your data in order for a pie chart to be a valid representation of the data?
cues.zh: 要讓圓餅圖有效表示資料，資料條件是什麼？

cues.en: So the condition on the data is that the total across all the pie pieces must sum to one if it's a proportion, or 100 if it's percent.
cues.zh: 條件是，所有圓餅塊加總，比例必須為1，百分比必須為100。

cues.en: So you could add up all these numbers and you'd find that they get to 100%.
cues.zh: 所以把這些數字相加，會得到100%。

cues.en: In fact, that's pretty simple to do.
cues.zh: 其實很容易算。

cues.en: We can take 21 plus 29, that's a natural grouping because of the one and the nine, so, you know, this is a little example of how to do math quickly or at least addition quickly.
cues.zh: 先取21加29，因為1和9，很自然能湊整數。這是快速做數學，至少快速加法的小例子。

cues.en: You bring this one from the 21 over here, so that gives us 20 and 30, and that's easy to add up to 50.
cues.zh: 把21裡的1移過去，得到20和30，很容易加成50。

cues.en: And here we can take the four from this 14, that leaves us with 10, and add the four here, so then we get 10 and 40, and that's also 50.
cues.zh: 再從14取出4，剩下10，把4加到這裡，得到10與40，也等於50。

cues.en: So can you think of an example of data, for example, data that we've already seen so far in this course, where a pie chart is not valid,
cues.zh: 能否想出一個資料例子，例如課程到目前為止已看過的資料，不適合用圓餅圖，

cues.en: a pie chart is an inappropriate way to visualize the data?
cues.zh: 用圓餅圖視覺化並不恰當？

cues.en: Well, an example is with this survey of how people get the news.
cues.zh: 例如，剛才調查人們如何取得新聞的問卷。

cues.en: Notice this violates our condition.
cues.zh: 注意，它違反這個條件。

cues.en: These data do not sum to 100.
cues.zh: 資料加總不是100。

cues.en: You can already see that, you know, clearly, internet plus TV is already gonna be 120 something percent.
cues.zh: 很明顯，網路加電視，就已經是120%多。

cues.en: So these data cannot be shown with a pie chart.
cues.zh: 所以這些資料不能用圓餅圖。

cues.en: Now that doesn't mean there's anything wrong with the data because people can get their news from multiple sources.
cues.zh: 不代表資料有問題，因為人們可能從多個來源取得新聞。

cues.en: It just means that we cannot visualize this kind of data, this result in a pie chart.
cues.zh: 只是這類資料、這個結果，無法用圓餅圖視覺化。

cues.en: So that was your introduction into pie charts.
cues.zh: 這就是圓餅圖的入門介紹。

cues.en: Again, the main idea of a pie chart is that the total area occupied by each piece of the pie corresponds to some proportion of the population or the sample
cues.zh: 主要概念是，每塊圓餅所占的面積，對應母體或樣本中，

cues.en: that shows that category, and the main condition, the main thing to remember about pie charts is that they are valid only when your data sum up
cues.zh: 顯示這個類別的某個比例。最重要、要記住的條件，是只有資料加總，

cues.en: to either one for proportion or 100 for percent.
cues.zh: 比例為1，或百分比為100時，才有效。

cues.en: To be honest, I'm not a huge fan of pie charts, I generally prefer showing bar plots instead of pie charts.
cues.zh: 老實說，我不是很喜歡圓餅圖，一般更喜歡用長條圖。

cues.en: Nonetheless, they are important to know about.
cues.zh: 不過，仍然需要了解。

cues.en: And in the next video, you will see some additional examples of pie charts in code.
cues.zh: 下一部影片，會看到更多用程式畫圓餅圖的例子。
